_about: Skill IDs from team/00_SHARED_CONTRACT.md §3. type drives the scenario shift rule: when the company's AI drafts or does a task, part of that task's EXECUTION-skill weight moves to OVERSIGHT skills (catalogue/company_assumptions.json). The classification is a team design choice (declared), documented per skill in type_reason.

skills.name: Reconcile to source
skills.description: Reconcile a balance back to source evidence (bank lines, documents).
skills.type_reason: Tracing and matching balances is the routine reconciliation work that an AI agent can draft.

skills.name: Duplicate detection
skills.type_reason: Scanning entries for duplicates is part of routine matching, which AI can perform.

skills.name: Cut-off and timing
skills.description: Judge period cut-off and timing items (deposits in transit, uncleared cheques).
skills.type_reason: Classifying timing items follows rules applied during preparation, which AI can draft.

skills.name: Challenge unsupported adjustments
skills.type_reason: Questioning whether someone else's (or the AI's) adjustment has a supporting document is review judgment, not preparation.

skills.name: FX conversion check
skills.description: Verify currency conversion and the rate used.
skills.type_reason: Applying and recomputing a conversion rate is a mechanical step AI can perform.

skills.name: Transposition check
skills.type_reason: Comparing keyed amounts with documents is checking-as-preparation, which AI can do row by row.

skills.name: Escalation judgment
skills.description: Decide to sign off, correct, or escalate.
skills.type_reason: Deciding and owning the outcome stays with a human in both scenarios (humans decide).

skills.name: AI output review
skills.description: Ask for the evidence that would change the AI's conclusion, including when the AI raises a false alarm.
skills.type_reason: Reviewing AI output is the core oversight skill; it only exists because AI drafts the work.

skills.name: Variance analysis
skills.description: Explain differences between budget, forecast and actual figures.
skills.type_reason: Computing and first-pass explanation of variances is analytical preparation that AI can draft.

skills.name: Data quality
skills.description: Check that data feeding reports and AI tools is complete, consistent and fit for use.
skills.type_reason: Judging whether inputs can be trusted is a review responsibility that grows when AI consumes the data.

skills.name: Controls design
skills.description: Design review and approval controls for finance processes, including AI-assisted steps.
skills.type_reason: Deciding where human checks sit in an AI-assisted process is oversight by definition.

skills.name: Process automation
skills.description: Build simple automated flows for routine finance steps.
skills.type_reason: Building automations is hands-on technical work (doing), not review of output.

skills.name: Stakeholder communication
skills.description: Explain findings, exceptions and decisions to managers and other teams.
skills.type_reason: Explaining and owning conclusions stays human when AI prepares the numbers.

skills.name: Forecasting
skills.description: Build and update forecasts from historical data and drivers.
skills.type_reason: Producing forecast numbers is model-driven preparation that AI can draft.

skills.name: Spreadsheet modelling
skills.description: Build clear, checkable spreadsheet models and schedules.
skills.type_reason: Building schedules and formulas is preparation work that AI can draft.

skills.name: SQL basics
skills.description: Query ledger and transaction data with basic SQL.
skills.type_reason: Writing queries to extract data is hands-on preparation.
